Abu Huraira, eager for hadith, asked who will be luckiest with the Prophet's intercession on Resurrection Day: one who said sincerely from the heart that none but Allah is worshipped.
At a meal the Prophet says on Resurrection Day people will seek intercession from Adam and Noah, who decline, then come to him, and he will prostrate beneath the Throne.
On Resurrection Day people gathered on one plain will ask Abraham to intercede, but remembering his lies he says 'Myself!' and sends them to Moses.
On the Day of Resurrection believers ask Adam, Noah, Abraham, Moses and Jesus to intercede; all decline; the Prophet intercedes until only those the Quran confines remain in Hell.
On Resurrection Day people in distress will ask Adam, Noah, Abraham, Moses and Jesus to intercede, each declining, until Muhammad prostrates beneath the Throne and his intercession is accepted.
On Resurrection Day nations will seek intercession until it is given to Muhammad at the praised station; whoever asks this for him after the adhan will receive his intercession.
A believer to a believer is like a building whose parts support each other, and the Prophet told them to help and recommend the needy for a reward.
Every prophet has one invocation that is answered, and the Prophet keeps his to intercede for his followers on the Day of Resurrection.
People will ask Adam, Noah, Abraham, Moses and Jesus to intercede, each declining, until Muhammad intercedes again and again, taking people out of the Fire into Paradise.
On Resurrection believers will seek intercession from Adam, Noah, Abraham, Moses and Jesus, then Muhammad, who intercedes again and again until those with an atom's weight of good leave Hell.
Believers on Resurrection go from Adam to Jesus, then to Muhammad, who intercedes three times and takes people out of Hell; this is the Station of Praise promised him.
Every prophet has one invocation surely answered, and the Prophet wishes, if Allah wills, to keep his as intercession for his followers on Resurrection.
When someone in need came, the Prophet told his companions to intercede for him and be rewarded, for Allah fulfils what He wills through His Messenger's tongue.
The Prophet will intercede repeatedly until those with faith of a mustard seed leave Hell; on a fourth plea Allah will take out all who said La ilaha illallah.
Believers gathered on Resurrection will ask Adam, father of mankind, to intercede with their Lord, and he will say he is not fit, mentioning his mistake.
